description: Passive, read-only security grade (A-F, 0-100) for a public domain, from public DNS, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), HTTPS/TLS and HTTP response headers. It is not a penetration test, and a good grade is not a security guarantee. Rate limit: 8 calls per minute per client; identical repeat queries are served from a 5 minute cache.

domain.description: Public domain to grade. Bare domain or subdomain only, no protocol, path or port. Examples: example.com, mail.google.co.uk.
domain.title: Domain
